decks.notes: This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Static Prison. Bloodstained Mire and Arid Mesa help fix mana while enabling fetchlands, and Goblin Bombardment provides reach and removal. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional value and flexibility to the deck. The main goal is to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game as quickly as possible.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble a combo using cards that do not require lands to be effective. By using cards like Whir of Invention and Jwari Disruption to find and protect combo pieces like Hydroelectric Specimen and Thundertrap Trainer, the deck aims to quickly create a winning board state without relying on traditional mana sources. Cards like Disrupting Shoal and Pact of Negation are included to help protect the combo from disruption, while cards like Sink into Stupor and Suppression Ray provide additional control elements to stall the opponent.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly bringing out aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride, backed up by powerful spells such as Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge. It also utilizes The One Ring to provide a boost to its creatures. The deck includes cards like Thraben Charm and Static Prison to control the board while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional threats to the opponent. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds another level of flexibility to the deck's strategy. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient aggression.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressively with low-cost creatures and powerful combat tricks. It aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly by flooding the board with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Amped Raptor while controlling the battlefield with cards like Static Prison and Lightning Bolt. The deck's strong synergy and efficient curve allow it to apply pressure early and maintain momentum throughout the game. Playing Ajani, Nacatl Pariah can further boost the aggression of the deck, backed up by support from cards like The One Ring.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures like Guide of Souls and Amped Raptor, backed up by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah helps pump up your team and Goblin Bombardment provides additional direct damage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds a powerful extra threat and ramp potential. The deck aims to maintain aggression and pressure throughout the game, leveraging its efficient creatures and powerful spells to close out games quickly.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to loop spells and artifacts from the graveyard. The goal is to generate infinite mana with Urza's Saga and Grinding Station, eventually winning with Thassa's Oracle by drawing out the entire deck. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student serves as card draw and disruption, while Unholy Heat and Malevolent Rumble provide removal and control. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a win.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of counter spells, hand disruption, and board control. It aims to control the game tempo by consistently removing threats and maintaining card advantage. With a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and disruptive creatures, the deck looks to outvalue the opponent and win through incremental advantage. Murktide Regent serves as a powerful finisher, while cards like Thoughtseize and Psychic Frog help to strip away the opponent's resources. Ultimately, the goal is to outlast the opponent and win the game through attrition.

Utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines, this Dimir Control deck aims to disrupt its opponent's game plan while gradually gaining control of the battlefield. The deck focuses on efficiently answering threats and controlling the pace of the game through card draw and selection. By using a mix of permission spells, removal, and versatile threats like Murktide Regent, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and secure victory through attrition. The key strategy revolves around card advantage and resource management to outlast the opponent and emerge victorious.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly and aggressively bringing out creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls to overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment and Lightning Bolt for direct damage, and Static Prison to control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional power boost to the deck. The aim is to maintain a steady offensive pressure while utilizing various spells and abilities to maintain board dominance and quickly finish off opponents.

The Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive strategies, using powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to quickly overwhelm opponents. It also includes a number of efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Static Prison to maintain control of the board. The deck is designed to quickly apply pressure and close out games before the opponent has a chance to recover. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra level of consistency and utility to the deck.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly deploy creatures and swiftly attack the opponent, aiming to deal damage efficiently and overwhelm them before they can stabilize. The deck includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls, supported by removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional synergy and flexibility. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining pressure and tempo to secure a victory through aggressive combat and direct damage.

The deck focuses on utilizing a landless combo strategy to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Disrupting Shoal and Pact of Negation to control the game, as well as powerful creatures like Fallaji Archaeologist and Thundertrap Trainer, the deck aims to quickly assemble the Goblin Charbelcher win condition. With a mix of support cards like Suppression Ray and control spells like Sink into Stupor, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own powerful combos to dominate the game.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and using them to deal a large amount of damage to the opponent early in the game. It also includes various cards that support this strategy, such as removal spells and utility lands. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an additional element to the deck, providing extra ramp and potentially enabling powerful plays. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient offense while maintaining some flexibility and versatility through its card choices.

The deck focuses on using instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to quickly bring back powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Ulamog, the Defiler from the graveyard to the battlefield. Using cards like Fallaji Archaeologist and Psychic Frog to fill the graveyard with creatures, the deck aims to create a game-winning combo by rapidly reanimating creatures and overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats. Additionally, cards like Thoughtseize and Solitude provide disruption and protection to ensure the combo can go off smoothly.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. The deck aims to control the board and slow down the opponent's plays while setting up its own win condition with cards like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's strategy, the deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent until it can secure a victory through its own threats and card advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Springleaf Drum and Ancient Stirrings, while controlling the board with cards like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command. The strategy also involves utilizing Eldrazi creatures like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker to dominate the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and The One Ring enhance the power of these creatures. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent through a combination of ramping and control elements, supported by Eldrazi creatures.
